worldcombat.skill.superpower.summary: Lowers its shoulder and drives low along the horizontal part of the aim to the first real contact: one heavy physical blow that knocks the target back, after which the user's Attack and Defense both drop. Hitting a wall or charging into empty air only raises a puff of dust and costs nothing; a grounded body never launches up at an airborne target.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.0: Open with the single heaviest hit up close
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.1: Knock a foe out of position
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.2: Force a high-output trade at close range on the ground
worldcombat.skill.superpower.description: Drives low and, on the first real body contact, deals about %1$s physical damage and knocks it about %2$s blocks along the contact line; heavier targets are pushed less.
Charge range %1$s blocks; on a hit the user's Attack drops %2$s stage(s) and Defense drops %3$s. Hitting a wall or empty air settles nothing and pays no stat cost.

Takes %1$s s to sink the weight in, then charges low along the horizontal part of the release aim at %2$s blocks/tick; it stops at the first body or wall, never curves around cover to chase the original target, and never launches up at an airborne target.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the knock-back to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.growth.1: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the charge range to %3$s blocks.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the charge from farther, but it is easier to sidestep mid-charge.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one heavy single hit finishes them before the price is paid; off: all targets score the same.
Below this own health ratio the user holds Superpower back (0 = no limit). Higher makes it save the hit for a worthwhile trade.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.description: The impact only raises a puff of dust and fist-light at the real body or wall contact, tinted by the material it touches; no block is changed, and a whiff leaves just a puff of dust.
